content_sections.heading: PGIMER Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PGIMER Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview, and candidates need to attend the interview on 08 September 2026. There is no separate application deadline before the interview.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Senior Resident post is MD (Anaesthesia).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies announced for the Senior Resident post at PGIMER.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years for General candidates, 43 years for OBC candidates, and 45 years for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the office of the undersigned at 4th floor, A Block, Nehru Hospital, PGIMER, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry their complete bio-data, attested copies of relevant certificates, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The job type for the Senior Resident post is Adhoc.

faq.question: Q10. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates need to report at 2:00 PM on 08 September 2026 for the walk-in interview.
